description: Per-property MCP server settings. Controls how a single field on a schema is exposed to AI agents — its description, whether it's visible in responses, and whether it can be filtered or sorted by.
formgrid:
description description description
expose filterable sortable

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

description.label: AI Description
description.help: Description shown to AI agents in tool input/output schemas. Falls back to the field's help text, then label, if blank. Write for AI consumption — what does this field semantically mean in the data model (not how to fill it in).
description.placeholder: e.g. The post's URL slug, used in the public URL /blog/{slug}

expose.label: Expose to MCP
expose.help: When disabled, this field is stripped from MCP responses. Use for internal-only fields (supplier costs, internal notes, etc.) that admins set but shouldn't reach AI agents.

filterable.label: Filterable
filterable.help: Whether this field can appear in include/exclude filters on query_collection. When blank, T3 infers from the field type (text/select/toggle/number/date are filterable by default).

sortable.label: Sortable
sortable.help: Whether this field can appear in the sort parameter on query_collection. When blank, T3 infers from the field type (number/date are sortable by default).
